scope: local TCP HTTP capture integration only; no independent attack labels

contract.transport: 127.0.0.1 TCP; temporary listener; no environment proxy
contract.request_id: server-generated random UUID-style hex; client IDs ignored
contract.body: actual complete ASGI bytes, max1MiB/1024chunks/5seconds; partial hash never treated as complete
contract.identity: existing API-key verifier and server-owned local service session; no external IdP/MFA
contract.runtime: fixed Python checksum child; no client command execution
contract.observations: signed authentication/authorization/runtime roles from trusted server hooks
contract.audit: private single-process receipt spool plus checkpointed durable risk ledger

limits: Same-process signing roles do not prove independent sensor isolation or hardware attestation.
Receipt capture occurs at ASGI response start; it does not prove client delivery or undo prior handler execution.
Only eligible encoded-command projections enter the existing v45-v47 path; other receipts remain unbound/unsupported.
Local service sessions are not end-user OIDC sessions or real MFA; actual production collectors and independent F1 evaluation remain pending.
Temporary demonstration recovery keys are not retained for operational backup reuse.
